title: Scripts
subtitle: Small programs on your computers that answer an address or run on a schedule.
search: Search scripts by name or address
col.name: Script
calls.title: {{calls}} calls in the last 24 hours, {{failed}} failed
empty.title: No scripts yet
empty.body: A script is a small program on one of your computers. Write one, or ask the assistant to write it for you.
group.problem.off: Turned off. Start it to see its scripts.
group.problem.starting: Starting. Its scripts show up when it is ready.
group.problem.private: Keeps its scripts private from the Hub. Allow access in the computer's settings to see them.
group.problem.unreachable: Did not answer. Check that it is running, then reload.
noAnswer.title: {{name}} didn't answer
noAnswer.body: The scripts could not be read. Check that the computer is on, then try again.
group.problem.old: Runs an older Scripts program. You can read and test its scripts. To change them, update the computer.
detail.gone: This script isn't here any more
detail.goneBody: It may have been deleted, or its computer is turned off.
notice.managed: Made from the idea “{{template}}”. The Hub does not edit it here.
notice.old: This computer runs an older Scripts program. You can read and test this script. To change it, update the computer.
overview.noUsageBody: Call counts need a newer Exec. Update the computer to see them.
overview.noCallsBody: When something calls this script, its calls and failures show here.
overview.hours: Calls per hour for the last 24 hours
overview.partial: These numbers cover only part of the last 24 hours.
overview.schedNone: No schedule. It runs only when something calls it.
overview.schedWhy.off: {{computer}} is off. Start it to change the schedule.
overview.schedWhy.old: This computer runs an older Scripts program. To change the schedule, update the computer.
overview.schedWhy.unknown: Can't tell who owns this script yet, so the schedule can't be changed. Reload to try again.
overview.schedWhy.managed: Made from the idea “{{template}}”. The Hub does not change its schedule here.
overview.runWhy.off: {{computer}} is off. Start it to run the script.
overview.runWhy.keyed: It needs a caller key, and a run from here sends none. Call its address with the key instead.
overview.runWhy.elsewhere: {{computer}} is not the computer shown now. Choose it in the top bar to run the script.
overview.runWhy.gone: It has no schedule now, so it can't be run from here.
run.ask.title: Run {{name}} now?
run.ask.body: It runs once, now, as its schedule would. Whatever it does happens now: it may send messages, change data or spend money.
run.ask.once: Its schedule stays as it is.
run.ask.lost: If no answer comes back, it is not sent again. Its runs show what happened.
share.title: Public links
share.body: A link anyone can open, without signing in, that runs this script.
share.who.q: Who can open a public link?
share.who.a: Anyone who has the link, without signing in. Opening it runs this script. You can turn a link off or remove it here.
share.noneBody: Make a link to let someone outside your team call this script.
share.dynamic: This address has a variable part. Make the link from a Share page for a fixed address.
share.removeBody: {{url}} stops working for everyone who has it.
share.removeWait: A change to this script's links is still going or not settled yet. Remove waits until it is.
share.why.noAddress: This file has no address of its own, so it can't have a public link.
share.why.managed: Made from the idea “{{template}}”: its links come with the idea, so the Hub doesn't make them here.
share.why.ownerReading: Checking whether this script was made from a Script idea. Making or changing links waits for that, so a link is never made twice.
share.why.ownerFailed.network: Can't check whether this script was made from a Script idea: the list of idea-made scripts on {{computer}} didn't come through. Making or changing links waits until it does, so a link is never made twice.
share.why.ownerFailed.forbidden: Can't check whether this script was made from a Script idea: the agent on {{computer}} refused to show its list of idea-made scripts. Making or changing links waits until it does, so a link is never made twice.
share.why.ownerFailed.not_found: Can't check whether this script was made from a Script idea: the agent on {{computer}} has no list of idea-made scripts to show. Making or changing links waits until it does, so a link is never made twice.
share.why.ownerFailed.other: Can't check whether this script was made from a Script idea: the list of idea-made scripts on {{computer}} didn't load. Making or changing links waits until it does, so a link is never made twice.
share.why.ownerFailed.signedOut: Can't check whether this script was made from a Script idea: the agent on {{computer}} isn't signed in. Sign it in above. Making or changing links waits until then, so a link is never made twice.
share.why.ownerFailed.rejected: Can't check whether this script was made from a Script idea: the agent on {{computer}} was signed out. Sign it in again above. Making or changing links waits until then, so a link is never made twice.
share.why.ownerFailed.noHost: Can't check whether this script was made from a Script idea: the agent on {{computer}} is signed in but couldn't open its list of idea-made scripts. This doesn't clear by itself and can't be fixed from the Hub yet. Making or changing links waits until it opens, so a link is never made twice.
share.why.ownerFailed.notOpen: Can't check whether this script was made from a Script idea: the agent on {{computer}} couldn't open its list of idea-made scripts. This doesn't clear by itself; Check again once the agent is signed in to your account. Making or changing links waits until it opens, so a link is never made twice.
share.why.waiting: A change to this script's links is still going. Making a link waits until it is done.
code.label: Script code
code.downloadRefused: This script is too long to save as one file. Copy it instead.
code.literals_one: {{count}} line looks like a secret kept in the code. Keep secrets in Settings instead.
code.literals_other: {{count}} lines look like secrets kept in the code. Keep secrets in Settings instead.
code.keyUnplaceable: The key can't be placed in this file's header. Move the first line of code below the comments.
code.readFailedBody: The computer didn't answer. Nothing was changed.
code.conflictBody: This script changed since you opened it.
code.notSent: It did not go through. The script is as it was. Save again.
code.refused: The computer refused the change. The script is as it was.
code.unknown: Still can't tell if it went through. Read the script before saving again.
code.managedBody: The Hub does not edit scripts made from an idea. You can read and test it.
code.unknownOwner: Can't tell who owns this script
code.unknownOwnerBody: The agent on this computer did not answer, so changes are off until it does. Reload to try again.
code.ownerReadingBody: Changes are off until the agent on this computer says whether this script was made from an idea.
code.ownerSignedOut: Can't check who owns this script
code.ownerSignedOutBody: The agent on this computer isn't signed in, so it can't say whether this script was made from an idea. Sign it in above. Changes stay off until then, so a script made from an idea is never edited by mistake. You can still read and test it.
code.ownerRejected: Can't check who owns this script
code.ownerRejectedBody: The agent on this computer was signed out, so it can't say whether this script was made from an idea. Sign it in again above. Changes stay off until then, so a script made from an idea is never edited by mistake. You can still read and test it.
code.ownerNoHost: Can't check who owns this script
code.ownerNoHostBody: The agent on this computer is signed in but couldn't open its list of scripts made from an idea. This doesn't clear by itself and can't be fixed from the Hub yet. Changes stay off until the list opens, so a script made from an idea is never edited by mistake. You can still read and test it.
code.ownerNotOpen: Can't check who owns this script
code.ownerNotOpenBody: The agent on this computer couldn't open its list of scripts made from an idea. This doesn't clear by itself; Check again once the agent is signed in to your account. Changes stay off until the list opens, so a script made from an idea is never edited by mistake. You can still read and test it.
owner.signedOut: The agent on {{computer}} isn't signed in, so this page can't check which scripts were made from an idea. Edit, Delete and links stay off until it is.
owner.rejected: The agent on {{computer}} was signed out, so this page can't check which scripts were made from an idea. Edit, Delete and links stay off until it is signed in again.
owner.signedOutShared: The agent on {{computer}} isn't signed in, so Edit, Delete and links stay off. You're using shared access: only the account's owner can sign this agent in.
owner.signingIn: Signing the agent on {{computer}} in to your account…
owner.signedIn: The agent on {{computer}} answered that it is signed in, but this page's own check doesn't show it yet. Check again reads both once more; nothing is sent again.
owner.otherAccount: The agent on {{computer}} is signed in to a different Hoody account, so this page can't check its scripts for you. To change that, sign it out in the Agent app on that computer, then Check again.
owner.adminAccount: An administrator account can't sign agents in from the Hub. Sign the agent on {{computer}} in in the Agent app on that computer, then Check again.
owner.signInRetry: The agent on {{computer}} wasn't signed in. Edit, Delete and links stay off until it is. You can try again.
owner.signInUnknown: The agent on {{computer}} may have been signed in, but we couldn't confirm it. Check again reads its status; nothing is sent again.
owner.signInRefused: The agent on {{computer}} wasn't signed in. Sign it in in the Agent app on that computer, then Check again.
owner.noHost: The agent on {{computer}} is signed in but couldn't open its list of scripts made from an idea, so Edit, Delete and links stay off. This doesn't clear by itself and can't be fixed from the Hub yet. You can still read and test the script. Check again reads the list once more.
owner.notOpen: The agent on {{computer}} couldn't open its list of scripts made from an idea, so Edit, Delete and links stay off. This doesn't clear by itself. Check again once the agent is signed in to your account.
code.oldKitBody: This computer runs an older Scripts program. Update the computer to change scripts from here.
change.protection_removed: Anyone can call it now: the key was removed.
change.schedule_added: It will run on a schedule: {{detail}}.
change.turned_off: It is turned off and will not answer.
change.public_spends_ai: It spends AI credit, and anyone can call it without a key.
change.public_changes_data: It changes data, and anyone can call it without a key.
change.address_taken: Another script answers this address now; this one will take it over.
versions.title: Versions
versions.body: Every save is kept, newest first. Restore puts an older one back as a new save.
versions.previewBody: This is what restoring it would change in the code. Nothing is restored until you press Restore this version.
versions.same: This version has the same code as the current one.
versions.tooBig: This version differs too much to show line by line.
versions.cantRestore: Restoring is off here: save or undo your edits first, or this script can't be changed from the Hub.
test.title: Try it
test.body: Send one request to the script as it is saved, and see what it answers.
test.sendAgainBody: Nothing here can tell whether the earlier request ran. Send again sends it once more. That may do the same thing twice.
test.stopTrackBody: Nothing here can tell whether the earlier request ran. Its body was not kept, so nothing is sent again. After this you can send a new request.
test.noSavedBody: Saved tests stay with the script on its computer.
test.oldKit: Saved tests need a newer Exec
test.oldKitBody: You can still send a request above.
set.enabledBody: Off, and the script does not answer or run on its schedule.
when.monthly: On day {{d}} of each month at {{time}}
pick.never: As written, this expression never runs.
pick.noCalc: The next runs can't be calculated here. The computer checks the expression.
key.title: Key
key.body: With a key, only callers who send it can run this script. A key is shown once, when it is made.
key.off: Open to anyone with the link
key.unseen: A key may have been made, but it can't be shown now. Press Make a new key to get one you can copy.
new.secretUnseen: The key may have been made, but it can't be shown now. Open the script and make a new key to get one you can copy.
new.ideasOffline: Ideas need the assistant service on this computer, and it isn't answering. Use Write the code myself, or try again in a moment.
new.ideasPickRealm: Pick one realm at the top to start from an idea. This computer is in more than one realm and every realm is shown.
key.unseenBeside: A key may have been added, but it can't be shown. It works until removed: use Remove all keys.
key.keep: A new key will be made and added beside the {{count}} keys this script has; they keep working. It is shown after saving.
key.countUnknown: Can't make a key here: the computer's read doesn't say how many keys this script has, and a new key could replace them all.
key.full: This script has {{count}} keys, the most the computer takes. Remove them all to start again.
key.held: This new key can't be checked or saved: the computer's latest read has no room for it, or doesn't say how many keys the script has. Undo it to save your other changes.
key.shownBody: Copy it now. It won't be shown again.
key.label: Key
check.notSent: That change was never sent, so nothing changed. You can try again.
check.failedFix: Its answer was {{code}}, so nothing changed. Change it and send it again here.
check.failedTests: Its answer was {{code}}, so the script's saved tests were kept. The script itself is deleted; a script made at the same place shows them on its Test tab, where you can remove them.
key.once: Callers send it as a header or in the address. Make a new key to replace it.
secrets.title: Secret values
secrets.body: Values the script reads from its environment. Names show here; values are never shown again.
secrets.oldKit: Secret values need a newer Exec
secrets.oldKitBody: Update the computer to keep secret values here.
secrets.name: Name
secrets.nameBad: Use only letters, numbers and _, not starting with a number, like API_TOKEN.
secrets.notSecretName: This name doesn't look like a secret, but the value is still kept hidden.
secrets.why.q: Why can't I see a saved value?
secrets.why.a: A saved value stays on the computer and is never sent back to the page. To change one, add it again under the same name.
delete.title: Delete this script
delete.body: The address stops answering. The computer keeps a copy for a while so you can bring it back.
delete.c2: You can restore it from Recently deleted.
delete.block.old: Delete needs a newer Exec on this computer.
delete.block.unknown: Delete is off until the agent answers.
delete.block.links: Delete is off until this computer's public links can be read, so none is left pointing at a deleted script.
delete.block.elsewhere: This script was made from an idea in another realm. Delete it there.
delete.block.noGuard: Delete for idea-made scripts needs a newer agent.
delete.block.held: Delete is off while a change to this script or its links is still being settled. Check it from Overview or Settings first.
deleted.title: Recently deleted
deleted.body: Deleted scripts are kept for a while. Restore brings one back at its old address.
new.title: New script
new.subtitle: Describe it or write it, check it, then make it live.
new.ideaBody: In your own words. The assistant writes the code; you check it before it goes live.
new.ex.summary: Summarise a web page with AI
new.ex.summary.fill: Take a web address I send, open the page in this computer's browser, and answer with the page title and a five-line summary written by AI.
new.ex.sitecheck.fill: Every hour, open my website in this computer's browser, have AI read the page and say whether anything looks wrong (an error message, an empty page, a missing price), and send me a notification only when something does.
new.ex.chat: Post events to my team chat
new.ex.chat.fill: An address other services can send events to. Only accept calls that send the script's key. Have AI turn each event into one short line people can read, and post it to my team chat channel through the channel's incoming webhook address, kept as a secret value.
new.ex.extract: Turn messy text into clean data
new.ex.extract.fill: Take an email or any text I send and answer with JSON holding the person's name, company, email address, phone number and what they ask for, filled in by AI with exactly those fields (empty when the text doesn't say).
new.ex.todo.fill: A small JSON API for a to-do list: add an item, list them, mark one done and delete one. Keep the items in this computer's database so they are still there after a restart, and only answer callers that send the script's key.
new.ex.docs.fill: Take a question, read the Markdown files in a folder I choose on this computer, and answer with AI using only what those files say, naming the file each part of the answer came from.
new.noWriter: The assistant isn't available. Use Write the code myself.
new.addressBad: Use letters, numbers, - and _ in each part, like /my-script.
new.addressReserved: A new script can't be made at this address. Pick another, like /my-script.
new.ideasBody: Ready-made scripts you can set up in a minute.
new.noComputer: No computer can take a script
new.noComputerBody: Start a computer with a current Exec first.
idea.http-healthcheck-notify: Check a website and notify me
idea.webhook-to-notification: Turn a webhook into a notification
ai.done: Written. Read the code, then check it for errors.
ai.err.no_block: The assistant answered without code. Try asking again.
ai.err.two_blocks: The assistant sent more than one file. Ask for a single script.
ai.err.unclosed: The assistant's answer was cut off. Try again.
ai.err.empty: The assistant sent an empty script.
review.title: Review
review.body: This follows every change you make. What is shown here is exactly what goes live.
review.takenBody: Another script answers this address. Pick a different address.
review.general: A general script answers this address now
review.generalBody: Yours will answer it instead, for this computer.
review.checkFirst: Check it for errors first: syntax, TypeScript and imports.
review.checkFailed: The code could not be checked
review.checkFailedBody: The computer gave no answer to the check, so nothing is known about the code yet. Press Check for errors again in a moment.
held.title: Held by another page
held.body: A change from {{page}} may have gone through. Check it there first; nothing was sent from here.
heldWrite.title: Saving script {{path}} on {{computer}} was not confirmed
heldWrite.known: Its answer was lost, so it may or may not have been saved.
heldWrite.checkLine: Check asks the computer what became of this save. Nothing is sent again.
heldWrite.kept.NOT_KNOWN: The computer could not say what became of it, so it is still not known. Check again later, or stop tracking it.
heldWrite.kept.IN_PROGRESS: The computer is still saving it. Check again in a moment.
heldWrite.kept.NOT_RECORDED: The computer cannot tell what became of this save, or whether it may still arrive. Look at the script, then stop tracking it.
heldWrite.kept.NO_OP: An older version of the Hub made this save, so the computer cannot be asked about it. Look at the script, then stop tracking it.
heldWrite.kept.KEPT: It could not be cleared just now. Check again later.
heldWrite.savedBody: The computer confirms this save went through.
heldWrite.notSent: Saving {{path}} did not reach the computer
heldWrite.notSentBody: The computer never received this save, and now it never can. Save it again if you still need it.
heldWrite.refusedBody: It was not saved ({{code}}). Save it again if you still need it.
heldWrite.unnamedTitle: A script save was not confirmed
heldWrite.stop: Stop tracking: the Hub stops following this save. Nothing is sent to the computer.
heldWrite.unnamedKnown: An older version of the Hub made it, and it names no script, so Check cannot read it. Look at your scripts, then stop tracking it.
outcome.pending.settings: The change may have gone through
live.unknown.title: It may have been made
live.unknown.body: {{computer}} didn't confirm. Don't send it again: Check again reads {{computer}} and shows what happened.
live.taken.title: Not made: the address was just taken
live.taken.body: A script was saved at {{route}} on {{computer}} after you checked it, so nothing was changed. Pick another address.
live.route.title: Not made: the address wouldn't reach this script
live.route.body: {{route}} would not have been answered by this script, so nothing was changed. Check the address before trying again.
live.unroutable.title: Not made: this address can't be used
live.unroutable.body: {{route}} can't be a script address. Nothing was changed. Pick another address.
live.fenced.body: {{computer}} settled this as never received, so nothing was changed. You can make it live again.
live.refused.body: {{computer}} refused it, so nothing was changed.
live.exists.title: Not made: the address is taken
live.exists.body: A script already exists at {{route}} on {{computer}}, so nothing was changed. Pick another address.
live.existsAfterUnknown: An earlier try may have made {{route}} on {{computer}}. Don't send it again: Check again reads {{computer}} and shows whether it is there.
live.reserved.title: Not made: the address is held
live.reserved.body: {{route}} is held by a script that is being deleted or moved, or by a link name. Nothing was changed. Pick another address, or try again once that change is done.
live.ideaHere: This idea can't be made here right now. Nothing was changed.
live.agentSignedOut: The agent on {{computer}} isn't signed in to your Hoody account, so nothing was made. Sign it in, then try again.
live.agentRejected: The agent's sign-in on {{computer}} is no longer valid, so nothing was made. Sign it in again, then try again.
outcome.pending.secrets: The value may have been kept
outcome.failed.links: Couldn't turn off its public link
outcome.pending.links: Turning off its public link may have gone through
outcome.not_sent.links: Its public link was not turned off
delete.linksStopped: Nothing was deleted: a public link of this script could not be turned off first. Fix that, then delete again.
delete.linksUnchecked: Nothing was deleted: this script's public links could not all be checked, or one of them changed meanwhile. Try again.
delete.linksOff: Its public links were turned off first. Turn them back on from Overview if you keep the script.
delete.testsLeft: The script is deleted, but its saved tests could not be removed.
delete.testsUnread: The script is deleted, but its saved tests could not be read, so they were not removed.
delete.testsPending: The script is deleted. Removing its saved tests may have gone through.
delete.testsPendingBody: Check again asks the computer what became of it. Nothing is sent a second time.
delete.testsHeldOlder: The script is deleted. Its saved tests were already being removed from another view, and that may have gone through.
delete.testsHeldOlderBody: Nothing was sent again. That removal stays with the view that sent it; a script made at the same place shows it with Check again.
outcome.pending.tests: The request may have gone through
err.generic: The computer refused the change. Nothing was changed.
err.BAD_REVISION: The script changed while you were editing. Reload it and try again.
err.SCRIPT_BUSY: The script is busy. Try again in a moment.
err.ENV_TOO_LARGE: That is too much to keep. Remove a value first.
err.ENV_LIMIT: That is too much to keep. Remove a value first.
err.INVALID_ENV_KEY: The computer does not take that name. Use letters, numbers and _, not starting with a number, and not a name the computer keeps for itself, like PATH or HOME. Nothing was changed.
err.INVALID_ENV_VALUE: The computer cannot keep that value: it has a line break, both kinds of quote marks, or is too long. Nothing was changed.
err.BAD_ARGS: Something in the request was wrong. Nothing was sent.
ai.title: Ask the assistant
ai.sub: Looking at {{name}}. Detected secrets in the code are masked. Your request and any prefilled error are not: check them for secrets.
ai.askBody: Say what should change. You review it before it is applied.
retryWhy.loading: The script's code hasn't loaded, so there's nothing to change yet.
retryWhy.code: This script has no code to change yet. Write some on the Code tab first.
retryWhy.idea: Describe what it should do first.
retryWhy.asking: Wait for the ask that is out to end first.
ai.unchecked: The check gave no answer. Ask again in a moment.
ai.emptyBody: Ask for a change and the assistant shows it here before anything is saved.
ai.codeIntro: Current code is shared with detected secret-like values replaced by placeholders.
ai.fixPrefill: This script fails with: {{error}}. Please fix it.
ai.err.placeholder: The assistant changed a hidden secret placeholder. Nothing was applied.
ai.err.unknown: The assistant could not answer. Nothing was changed.
ai.err.unknownCode: The assistant could not answer ({{code}}). Nothing was changed.
ai.err.noCredentials: The assistant's model needs a key on this computer before it can answer. In AI, use Connect an account, then try again. Nothing was changed.
ai.err.unconfigured: The assistant on this computer has no model set up yet. In AI, connect an account or choose a model, then try again. Nothing was changed.
ai.err.agentAuth: The coding assistant this computer hands the work to is not signed in. Sign it in again on this computer, then try again. Nothing was changed.
ai.err.realmUnknown: The assistant could not confirm which realms its sign-in on this computer may use, so it stopped. Sign the assistant in again, then try again. Nothing was changed.
ai.err.realmNotAllowed: The assistant's sign-in on this computer may not work in this realm. Switch to a realm it may use, or sign it in again with this realm, then try again. Nothing was changed.
code.narrow: Editing needs a wider screen. The code is read-only here.
new.ideaHint: Pick a starting point. You can edit everything after.
new.secretBody: This key is shown once. Store it somewhere safe before you close this.
force.label: Stop tracking without knowing
force.title: Stop tracking without knowing?
force.body: Nothing here can tell whether the change went through. Stopping tracking lets you do it again, which may do it twice.
run.checking: The earlier run is still being checked
run.checkingBody: It may have started. Look at its runs first. Running it again may start a second run.
run.pendingBody: Look at its runs before starting it again.
run.check: Stop tracking and allow another run
run.notShown: Its computer is not the one shown now, so nothing was sent. Choose it in the top bar, then run it again.
set.scheduleBody: Runs on a schedule you set under Schedules.
test.alertBody: Open the Hub to see the answer.
test.noHeaders: No headers the page can read.
test.withheldNote: This request sent something you typed. The answer may repeat it, so it stays hidden until you show it.
test.noAnswerBody: Send a request to see what the script answers.
test.removeBody: It is taken off this script's saved tests.
test.runWait: A request is still out or may have gone through. Run waits until it is settled.
test.removeWait: A change to the saved tests is still going. Remove waits until it is done.
idea.ai-summarize.body: Send it some text and it answers with a short summary.
idea.http-healthcheck-notify.body: Checks an address on a schedule and tells you when it stops answering.
idea.kv-note.body: Saves and reads back one small note at its address.
idea.scheduled-ai-digest.body: Writes a short digest on a topic you choose, on a schedule.
idea.webhook-to-notification.body: Turns a call from another service into a notification for you.
ai.warn.vanished: The proposal drops something that was in the script. Ask for a change that keeps it.
ai.warn.duplicated: The proposal repeats a block that is already in the script. Ask again.
magic.title: Magic comments
magic.body: The settings written at the top of the script: whether it runs, its schedule, its key and more. The list comes from this computer. Check your changes, then save them.
magic.why.a: Each setting is a line at the top of your code. The list of settings comes from this computer.
magic.f.log-exclude-headers: Headers left out of the log
magic.f.label: Label
magic.h.enabled: Off: the address stops answering and scheduled runs stop.
magic.h.token: Callers send this key to use the script's address.
magic.h.mode: Whether the script stays loaded, keeping what it set, or starts fresh for each request.
magic.h.timeout: Give each request at most this long to reply. A number with a unit, like 30s or 5m; 0 for no limit.
magic.h.concurrent: How many requests run at once: true for no limit, false for one at a time, or a number like 5.
magic.h.websocket: Accept WebSocket connections on the script's address. Needs Stays loaded.
magic.h.websocket-pre: Run the folder's pre.js before each WebSocket connection opens.
magic.h.schedule: When the script runs by itself, in UTC.
magic.h.schedule-timeout: Free the slot for the next scheduled run after this long. A number with a unit, like 90s or 5m; 0 for no limit.
magic.h.log-level: How much each run writes to its log.
magic.h.debug: The same as Log detail set to Debug.
magic.h.log-request-body: What callers send: full, redacted or off.
magic.h.log-response-body: What the script answers: full, redacted or off.
magic.h.log-max-body-size: Longer bodies are cut in the log. A size, like 512kb or 1mb.
magic.h.log-exclude-headers: Header names whose values never reach the log, separated by commas.
magic.h.log-retention-days: Days before old log entries are removed.
magic.h.debug-instrument: Record more about each run, to find a problem.
magic.h.cors: Which other website may call the script from a browser: reflective (any), none, or one address.
magic.h.cors-credentials: Let calls from that website carry its cookies and sign-ins.

faq.whatIsScript.a: A script is a small program on one of your computers. It answers an address or runs on a schedule. Write one yourself, or ask the assistant to write it for you. Each folder has its own web address and its own scripts; most people only use folder 1.
faq.needCode.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.needCode.a: No. Describe what you want in your own words and the assistant writes the code; you read it and check it for errors before it goes live. If you already have the code, choose Write the code myself; for a quick start, choose Start from an idea.
faq.whatCan.a: It answers its address, runs on a schedule, or both. In the code it can use AI with no key to set up, open and read web pages in this computer's browser, send you a notification, keep data in a database on this computer, read and write the computer's files, and call any web service.
faq.assistant.q: How does the assistant write a script?
faq.assistant.a: Describe it in your own words. The assistant on the computer writes it, and you check it before it goes live. It keeps going if you leave the page; come back from Scripts. When you ask it to change a script, you review the change before it is applied. Before the current code is shared, the page replaces detected secret-like values with placeholders. Review your request and your code for secrets before sending. It works through the agent on that computer, which has to be signed in.
faq.schedule.q: How do I make a script run on a schedule?
faq.schedule.a: For a script you can edit, use its schedule setting. When you create a script yourself, choose "Also on a schedule" and a preset or your own schedule (cron). It has five parts: minute, hour, day of the month, month, day of the week. Times are UTC. Examples of what people ask the assistant for: every Monday at 9:00, every hour, every night. A script made from an idea may run only when called, or on the schedule its generated code sets (UTC).
faq.publicLink.q: What is a public link, and how is its name chosen?
faq.publicLink.a: A public link is a link anyone can open, without signing in, that runs this script. It is off by default; for an eligible live script, make one from Overview. For an address with a variable part, make a link for a fixed address from a Share page. The name is 3 to 61 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, not starting or ending with a dash. The random ending keeps the address from being guessed; a short name of your own can be found by anyone who tries it. A new link can take about a minute to start working while the address spreads (DNS).
faq.accessKey.q: How does a script key work?
faq.accessKey.a: With a key, only callers who send it can run the script. Callers send it as a header or in the address. A key is shown once, when it is made, so copy it right away; if you lose it, make a new key to replace it. Without a key the script is open to anyone with the link.
faq.secrets.q: Where do I keep secrets such as passwords or API keys?
faq.secrets.a: When this computer supports secret values and the script is editable, in Settings under Secret values, not in the code. These are values the script reads from its environment. Names show; values are never shown again, and a value is kept hidden even if its name doesn't look like a secret.
faq.settingsAtTop.q: What are magic comments, and what do the settings do?
faq.settingsAtTop.a: They are the settings written at the top of the script: whether it runs, its schedule, its key and more. Each setting is a line at the top of your code. The list comes from the computer. Check your changes, then save them. Turning "On" off means the script does not answer or run on its schedule.
faq.versionsAndDelete.q: Can I undo a change or bring back a deleted script?
faq.versionsAndDelete.a: You can restore an earlier version, or a deleted script while its copy is kept, when the computer allows it. Every save is kept; Restore puts an older version back as a new save, and nothing is restored until you press Restore this version. A deleted script's address stops answering, but the computer keeps a copy for a while. Open Recently deleted: Restore brings it back at its old address, unless that address is now in use; it can be unavailable if ownership cannot be checked or another realm manages the script.
